lines.label: What it holds
lines.value: A search of registered products by trade name, registration number, applicant or generic name, filterable by human, biological, herbal, veterinary and other categories.

lines.label: Authorisation
lines.value: Under EDA Chairman Decree No. 450 of 2023, a company submits a registration request for a human pharmaceutical product, with a Common Technical Document required to complete the registration file, and the request follows set tracks and timelines.

lines.label: Scheme
lines.value: Unique identification number per pack issued by the Unified National Electronic Pharmaceutical Track-and-Trace System

lines.label: Rule
lines.value: Under EDA Chairman Decree No. 475 of 2025, each pack of human medicinal and biological product is assigned a unique identification number issued by the track-and-trace system with minimum data set out in the regulatory guideline, applying to imported finished products from 1 February 2026 and to locally packaged or manufactured products from 1 August 2026.
